title: Cuisinart Freeze Wand Ice Cream Maker $85.99 (RRP $149) Delivered @ Amazon AU (Excl. NT)
body:
Deal: Cuisinart Freeze Wand Ice Cream Maker $85.99 (RRP $149) Delivered @ Amazon AU (Excl. NT)

[dangerdanger] Thanks OP, keen to give it a try. Have bought!
[Soapdroid] Oh sweet, I've been eyeing the ninja, but I live in a van and this looks a lot better for that purpose. Cheers mate
[jt0505t] if you tight for room, especially in a van. this would be perfect.
[sky42856] Was on the fence about a creami due to countertop space. This did it for me! Managed to get another $20 off from Amazon voucher.
[jt0505t] You can use the same recipes as a ninja creami. The Ninja Creami pot is 470ml and Cuisinart Freeze Wand® Ice Cream Maker pots are 240ml, You just fill up two x 240ml pots with the mixture you have made.
I have been using A.I to help create the recipes. Works a treat.
[ne-us] Good for slushies? Don’t want a giant slushie machine on my kitchen bench…😌
